contributions.statement: When turning merged PRs into internal agent eval tasks, accept a task only if its target checks go pass -> fail -> pass across healthy, task and restored states while regression checks pass throughout, repeated runs are stable, and a scope gate stops the solution from touching protected checks.
contributions.evidence: §3 validation and scope/fidelity gates; §RQ1 Fig. 4: 900/1,130 eligible changes verified (79.6%); Table 1: 80.5% vs 62.3% for a re-implemented SWE-smith PR-mirror baseline on 621 matched Bug Fix cases.

contributions.statement: An internal eval set mined from history can be re-hosted on current main without changing aggregate agent outcomes, so refresh it to the live codebase instead of freezing old snapshots.
contributions.evidence: §RQ3 Table 2: 3,600 historical/reconstructed pairs, 89.7% outcome agreement, kappa 0.787, paired difference 0.0pp [-1.1, 1.1]; abstract's 98.0% is the best cell. Includes Java and API-migration tasks; single-repo only.

reason: Gives a validated recipe and an agreement measurement for building a refreshable internal eval from the team's own PRs; cross-repo changes are out of scope.
